recognize_zh: 兩個小型淋巴球核濃密均質，右上那顆的淡藍胞質中可見彎曲、互相交錯的細絲狀包涵體（filamentous inclusions），在 CLL 背景下這是免疫球蛋白結晶類包涵體的表現。
features: Small to medium mature lymphocytes with dense, homogeneous, deeply staining nuclei
Irregular/angular nuclear outlines; nucleoli not prominent
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm containing curvilinear, interlacing filamentous inclusions
Inclusions are pale, non-refractile and occupy part of the cytoplasm adjacent to the nucleus
Background with numerous crenated red cells (echinocytes) and scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mature-appearing lymphocytes with dense homogeneous chromatin and moderately abundant pale cytoplasm. One lymphocyte contains curvilinear, interlacing filamentous cytoplasmic inclusions, and the second shows a subtler inclusion. The background red cells are crenated. In a patient with known CLL, findings are consistent with CLL cells bearing filamentous (likely immunoglobulin-related crystalline) intracytoplasmic inclusions.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections and oval or bean-shaped nuclei with CD103/CD11c/CD25 positivity, not internal filaments.

ddx.dx: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma / plasmacytoid lymphocytes with Russell or Dutcher-type inclusions
ddx.vs: LPL inclusions are usually round globules rather than wavy filaments, and flow shows CD5-negative clonal B cells with an IgM paraprotein.
Reactive lymphocytes show basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells without filamentous inclusions and are polyclonal.
